label: The Armature of the Horse
summary: A book on casting and internal armature, consulted for the colossal equestrian monument to Francesco Sforza.

value.text: no. 99, Science, Mathematics, Engineering and Military

claims.statement: Entered as no. 99 in the reconstructed catalogue of Leonardo's books, under Science, Mathematics, Engineering and Military. Leonardo's wording as rendered there: "the armature of the horse".
